data.one_liner: A reactive state management library bringing signals to Dart and Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Alien Signals provides a reactive graph and propagation engine featuring signals, lazy computed values, and effects. It allows developers to track state changes automatically, optimize derived state with caching, and manage effect cleanup and scopes without code generation.
use_when: You want fine-grained reactivity using signals in Dart or Flutter
You need lazy-evaluated computed state with minimal overhead
avoid_when: Your project already heavily relies on an established architectural state pattern like BLoC or Riverpod
strengths: Simple and intuitive API with signal, computed, and effect functions
Supports lazy computed values, effect cleanup, and batch operations

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a more comprehensive, compile-safe state management solution designed specifically for Flutter.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you require strict event-driven architecture with predictable state transitions.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a simpler inherited widget-based dependency injection and state approach.
